name: BOV M16 Milos
protection: V-hull, STANAG 4569 Level III front / II-III elsewhere, mine IIa/IIb. Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Compact 4x4 V-hull MRAP with four side doors and a rear hydraulic ramp
Six roof smoke dischargers and an RWS
Large aluminium wheels, 420 mm ground clearance
